title: Beginner Mixology Class
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Have you ever wanted to learn how to craft cocktails like an international Mixologist?

We offer a hands-on experience in muddling, shaking, stirring, and sipping!

Other skills learned - how to balance a cocktail, how to create sour mix, some with egg white, Simple syrups, infusions, muddling skills, speed and accuracy. 

We are now offering smoked cocktail classes! 

We offer a real bar, real bar equipment in a comfortable space in Downtown Denver! 

Examples of what we Teach -

Espresso Martini
Egg white cocktails
Smoked Old Fashioned
Spicy Mango Margarita
Rum Coconut Daiquiri
